title: Services Configuration
description: Canonical catalog of LGU Services. Each Service is a single source of truth: a catalog card, optionally carrying a rich `detail` block for its /service-details/<id> page.

services.description: All Service records across every category

categoryId.description: Slug of the parent category (must match a categories.json id)

keywords.description: Search terms for the fuzzy search composable

providedBy.description: Slug of the Office that provides this Service (must match an offices.json id). The first-class Service -> providedBy -> Office reference. A Service sets at most one of providedBy / providedByAgency / providedByBarangay (see ADR-0004).

providedByAgency.description: Slug of the Agency that provides this Service (must match an agencies.json id) — a national government office in the city (e.g. PNP), not a city Office. See ADR-0004. Mutually exclusive with providedBy / providedByBarangay.

providedByBarangay.description: True when this Service is obtained at the resident's own Barangay (a directory marker, not a single provider ref — see ADR-0004 and the /barangays page). Mutually exclusive with providedBy / providedByAgency.

url.description: Destination route. `/service-details/<id>` when a `detail` block is present; otherwise the category page (e.g. `/services/certificates`).

seoDescription.description: SEO meta-description template for the /service-details/<id> page. Supports {{lguName}} interpolation. Read by the SEO middleware via getServiceSeoDescription.

serviceDetail.description: Optional rich content for the dedicated service-details page.

sources.description: Documents this Service was transcribed from, primary first (#243, ADR-0005).

sourceRef.description: One document a record was transcribed from (#243, ADR-0005). Only `name` is required: the validator deliberately enforces nothing else about provenance (#237) — render, not validation, is what makes an unsourced verification claim unreachable.

name.description: Issuing authority and document, e.g. "Las Piñas City Civil Registry Citizen's Charter, 2024 edition". Names the city, never this site.

url.description: Link to the document, present only when the authority publishes it. Absent for a tarpaulin or a PDF handed over on request; its absence never makes a record unverified (#238). Never a contributor's own photo or scan.

published.description: Vintage of the source itself, e.g. '2022'. Kept separate from verifiedOn so a fresh check cannot present old data as current. Nothing computes from it — there is no stale threshold (#237).

verifiedOn.description: ISO date this record was checked against THIS source. Asserts transcription accuracy, not currency.

covers.description: Field names this source backs, e.g. ["phone"]. Omitted for the source backing the record generally. Stored for auditability, not rendered.
